def prefix_different_loop.body
  (bytes : Slice Std.U8) (candidate : Slice Std.U8) (offset : Std.Usize) :
  Result (ControlFlow Std.Usize (Option Bool))
  := do
  let i := Slice.len candidate
  if offset < i
  then
    let i1 ← Slice.index_usize bytes offset
    let i2 ← Slice.index_usize candidate offset
    if i1 != i2
    then ok (done (some true))
    else let offset1 ← offset + 1#usize
         ok (cont offset1)
  else ok (done none)

@[rust_loop]
def prefix_different_loop
  (bytes : Slice Std.U8) (candidate : Slice Std.U8) (offset : Std.Usize) :
  Result (Option Bool)
  := do
  loop
    (fun offset1 => prefix_different_loop.body bytes candidate offset1)
    offset

/-- [aspis_s126_sdk_proof_gate::prefix_different]:
    Source: 'src/lib.rs', lines 20:0-28:1
    Visibility: public -/
def prefix_different
  (bytes : Slice Std.U8) (candidate : Slice Std.U8) : Result Bool := do
  let i := Slice.len bytes
  let i1 := Slice.len candidate
  if i < i1
  then ok true
  else
    let pending_return ← prefix_different_loop bytes candidate 0#usize
    match pending_return with
    | none => ok false
    | some b => ok b
